# Button

A button for one action, in three weights that follow the Psi and Omega shape rule.

`Omega.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Omega.Button />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Omega.Button"></x-import>
```

## Notes

solid realizes (run, build), outline checks, quiet navigates.
